name: Dreams of Adrina
source:
In a tranquil seaside town, a young golden jackal named Simon believes he's successfully closed himself off from the dangers of the outside world. However he soon gets involved in a tale of ever greater political intrigue once he meets a mysterious fox named Valéry, who will turn his life upside down and whom he will follow to the opulent city of Adrina and beyond...

[From [url=https://projectnewmoon.itch.io/dreams-of-adrina]Itch.io[/url]]
